shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic figure (A's stick figure; B's face-like glyphic elements)
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic incised linework including curving forms and a humanoid element, but A shows a sparse, isolated stick figure beside a single long undulating serpent-like line with one dot, while B is a densely packed all-over field of interlocking angular and spiral glyph-like motifs with face-like masks. The relationships (one figure confronting one wavy line versus a tightly tessellated composition filling the entire stone) and the drawing conventions (thin uniform open contour versus broad relief-carved interlocking blocks) are quite different.
